name: longmemeval_fixture
note: Small, LongMemEval-shaped fixture for offline end-to-end runs. NOT the real dataset. Hand-authored to span the six question types plus abstention, with varied evidence distance and haystack size so the order-parameter estimators have a gradient. Sessions are short; haystacks tiny. Use --source hf for the real benchmark.
